tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
Aramaic of ra.mot gi.l.ad (רָמֹת "Ramoth" H7433)
§ Jegar-sahadutha = "witness heap"
the mound of stones raised as witness between Jacob and Laban, called by Jacob in Hebrew 'Galeed'

-sahadutha = "of witness"
the mound of stones raised as witness between Jacob and Laban, called by Jacob in Hebrew 'Galeed'
Combined with ra.mot gi.l.ad (רָמֹת "Ramoth" H7433)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Jegar-Sahadutha, a cairn East of the Jordan
strongs_1890.derivation: (Aramaic) from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to H7717 (שָׂהֵד); heap of the testimony;
